steps.name: Oracle expansion and alignment diagnostics
steps.objective: Expand declared visual fixtures across text, Unicode, paragraphs, math and multipage cases; add page registration, crop/alignment diagnostics and region metrics.
acceptance: Registration error is separated from rendering error
Overlays retain fixture and component SHAs

steps.name: Preview-export visual non-regression
steps.objective: Gate native preview and exported PDF raster consistency against pinned references with explicit tolerances and visual review artifacts.
acceptance: Per-region thresholds cover glyphs, rules, baselines and page geometry
